Tools necessary for repairing and crafting metal equipment, including basic tools and weapons. Includes welder and basic smithing tools.

Cost: 150cr x TL.

*Tools and Tech Level: These tools are dependent on the desired tech level wanted by the spacer. The tech level of the tools can be used to repair, construct, or fabricate items, objects, vehicles, etc. of equal tech level or below. For Example, a TL 11 electronics tool set costs 550cr, can repair any electronics up to TL 11, and can only be purchased on worlds with TL 11 or higher. Book cost: "x TL" (cost per tech level); the cost field holds the per-TL cost, and the TL field is 0 (choose the tech level).

Tools and Tool Kits: All tool kits are capable of the listed description for all items of the tool kits’ tech level or less.
